4. Health, exercise, and nutrition: essential notice

BuildUp provides educational information and general fitness and nutrition tools; it does not provide medical services, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation, clinical dietetic care, or psychological care. It is not a medical device.

The programs are designed by an ISSA-certified personal trainer; this certification is not a medical or dietetics license. We do not have physicians, registered dietitians, or mental health professionals providing the app’s services.

Calorie and macro targets are generated automatically using general formulas and the data you enter, without an individual assessment. Food and recipe quantities and values are approximate and may be inaccurate or unsuitable for you.

Consult a physician or another qualified professional before starting or changing an exercise or nutrition routine, especially if you are pregnant, postpartum, or breastfeeding; have an injury, a heart or metabolic condition, or a pre-existing illness; take medication; or have a history of eating disorders.

Calorie counting can be harmful for some people; stop using that feature and seek professional help if it causes distress or risky behavior. Do not use the app’s estimates as instructions for managing illnesses, allergies, pregnancy, or nutritional deficiencies.

Understand the risks of the equipment and spaces where you exercise, use proper technique, and choose an appropriate intensity. Stop exercising immediately if you experience pain, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or other concerning symptoms; seek urgent care in an emergency.

Physical activity carries a risk of injury, and each person decides whether to participate. We do not promise weight loss, muscle gain, or any specific result.
